components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #d4b27a; color: #080808; padding: 0.9rem 2.2rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e6c896; transform: translateY(-2px); letter-spacing: 0.28em; }

components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); color: #eae7e1; padding: 0.9rem 2.2rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #d4b27a; color: #d4b27a; transform: translateY(-2px); letter-spacing: 0.28em; }

components.name: Album Card
components.description: Clickable grid card representing a photo album.
components.html:
12 fotos
Ensaios ExternosLuís Eduardo Magalhães
components.css: .ds-album-card { min-height: 180px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); background: #121212; padding: 1.5rem; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; position: relative; border-radius: 0; transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-album-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.95) 0%, rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.3) 100%); z-index: 1; transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-album-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: #a48450; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); } .ds-album-card-content { position: relative; z-index: 2; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; gap: 2.5rem; } .ds-album-count { background: rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.6); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); color: #d4b27a; font-size: 0.55rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.3rem 0.7rem; border-radius: 2px; align-self: flex-start; } .ds-album-title { font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif; font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 400; color: #eae7e1; display: block; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; } .ds-album-meta { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.65rem; color: #a09d95; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; display: block; }

narrative.overview: This visual system treats the web interface as the chassis of a high-end camera. The canvas is dark and unobtrusive, mirroring the sensory experience of a darkroom or a cinema, allowing the photographs themselves to command full attention.
keyCharacteristics: Pure dark background canvas to emphasize color and contrast in photos.
High contrast serif typography paired with strict, technical monospaced metadata.

rules.name: The Golden Thread Rule
rules.body: The Chamber Gold accent color must represent less than 10% of any single viewport surface. Its power is in its scarcity.

rules.name: The Balanced Heading Rule
rules.body: Always apply text-wrap: balance to headings (H1-H3) to prevent awkward line breaks and orphaned words.

rules.name: The Flat Rest Rule
rules.body: Containers and buttons are perfectly flat at rest. Elevation shadows and glow states must only occur in response to user interaction (hover, active, focus).

dos: Do wrap image assets in viewport-like border containers with overflow: hidden to simulate camera framing.
Do use monospace metadata (shutter speed, ISO, focal length) alongside portfolio photos to reinforce technical authenticity.
Do ensure all elements have high contrast ratios (body text is Parchment White or Muted Gray on Obsidian Black/Dark Slate).
donts: Don't use standard SaaS metric templates (large number + tiny label) to showcase stats.
Don't use gradient text under any circumstances.
Don't use border-left/right greater than 1px as decorative side-stripes.
Don't use card radii larger than 4px. Insanely rounded corners are forbidden.
